scheme_name: RMEWF-Financial Assistance To 100% Disabled Child Of Ex-Servicemen
other_conditions: Child must be a legitimate offspring of the ex‑serviceman or widow
Ex‑serviceman must be of rank JCO/equivalent of Navy/Air Force or below
Applicant must not be receiving any disability benefit from any official agency
Application must be recommended by the respective Zila Sainik Board (ZSB)
benefits_summary: Financial assistance of Rs.3000 per month (paid annually) per child, non‑transferable and ceases upon the child's death
documents_required: Copies of supporting documents duly attested by the respective Zila Sainik Welfare Officer (ZSWO)
Disability Certificate in the Government‑prescribed format (required for renewal)
